# 404X1

> Community site for 404 ERROR, an experimental Token-2022 meme token on X1 mainnet (SVM-compatible layer-1). Token dashboard with live 404/XNT price from on-chain swaps, wallet sign-in, global chat, direct messages, an arcade game and reputation points. Built by ARKBS Labs.
